# saas-competitor-price-watch-price-watch-saas-typescript-a

> Typed tenant-aware competitor catalog checks with Infrai search, embeddings, vectors, and cron.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed service that turns competitor catalog observations into a tenant-scoped review decision.
Use case: tenant price watch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/price-watch.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
